simulation.production_configuration_note: TB uses IF_COUNT=2,EQN_WIDTH=6,TQ_INDEX=13; fpga_k35 default IF_COUNT=1,EQN_WIDTH=5,TQ_INDEX=11
simulation.independent_oracle_note: Integration-level oracle absent; only loopback self-consistency (TX encrypt -> RX decrypt, same key same core). HLS C-sim has independent OpenSSL golden (300 vec) but that is core-internal only.

independent_experiments_executed.E1_auth_before_release: CONFIRMED_BEHAVIORAL (iverilog: production macsec_tag_strip FSM CAPTURE->OUTPUT->DRAIN->WAITTAG with corrupt 0xDEAD tag emitted, never ST_DROP; static: only drop path is length<MIN_FRAME_BYTES at line 257, zero tag-comparison branches)
independent_experiments_executed.E2_reset_pn_rollback: CONFIRMED_BEHAVIORAL (iverilog: tx_pn 1->6 during frame1, hls_rst -> tx_pn=1 (PN_INIT), frame2 restarts at tx_pn=1 same key => same (key,PN) nonce reused)
independent_experiments_executed.S3_to_S8: NOT_RUN (would pollute evidence given non-deterministic integration regression; require separate temp TBs)

simulation.existing_regression_note: sim_build/test_fpga_core/*_results.xml corpus (04-24..04-30) shows intermittent results: 44 PASS / 23 FAIL overall; full-length (wall>=1000s) FAIL on 04-24x1,04-28x5,04-29x1 versus PASS on 04-28x4,04-30x3. Same DUT/TB yields both PASS and FAIL on the same day (04-28). .pytest_cache/lastfailed=true (consistent). Regression is NOT deterministically passing -> not trustworthy.
false_pass_risk: check_stage strictly compares tx_in==tx_out, rx_in==rx_out +/- pause (frame counts only), NEVER payload/tag/auth content
loopback (sfp_sink->sfp_source) makes TX/RX same-key self-consistent -> masks tag/cipher errors
no independent MACsec frame injection, no negative auth tests
only single key/SSCI/fixed IV/fixed AAD tested
rx_in==rx_out tolerates dropping all-and-failing (if RX never drops, counts equal even with no crypto work)
INTERMITTENT: same DUT/TB produced both PASS and FAIL full-length runs (04-28: 5 FAIL + 4 PASS); lastfailed=true persists -> cannot claim deterministic pass
simulation.continuous_frames_note: Long runs at frame-count level pass; no per-frame identity binding, no multi-SA.
simulation.random_backpressure_note: No random tvalid/tready or tag-channel stall tests; loopback uses moment-level handshake only.
simulation.reset_matrix_note: Startup reset only; no warm/crypto/wrapper/MAC/HS reset; no reset mid-frame; reset-PN rollback is a GAP (fixed to PN_INIT).
simulation.negative_auth_note: No negative tag/cipher/AAD/IV/key tests; RX does not authenticate, so would not drop anyway.
simulation.post_synthesis_note: No post-synth/routed/SDF simulation exists. routed timing not met (WNS<0). -> POST_ROUTE_SECURITY_BEHAVIOR_UNPROVEN
coverage_gaps: SA lifecycle, key switch atomicity, generation, zeroization

security.nonce_uniqueness: NONCE_REUSE_STRUCTURAL_RISK (same key TX+RX sharing key id; reset rolls PN back to PN_INIT; no unique SSCI per node; no wrap fail-close; no PN persistence)
security.authentication_before_release: BLOCKER (macsec_rx_wrapper releases plaintext in OUT_DEC regardless of tag; top icv_check_enable=1'b0, received_icv=0; get computed ICV never compared)
security.fail_closed_behavior: GAP (only length<24B drop; auth fails not dropped; bypass if enable=0)
security.key_handling: GAP (plaintext key in FF, no zeroization, single constant key, no generation)
security.reset_security: BLOCKER (reset rolls PN to start with same key -> nonce reuse potential; no H/Y/table invalidation test)
security.standard_compliance: NOT_IMPLEMENTED (custom IV {SSCI,PN,0x5C5C5C5C}, custom AAD, no replay window, not full 802.1AE)
blockers: B1 nonce uniqueness: shared key TX/RX + reset-PN rollback + non-unique SSCI
B2 AUTHENTICATION_BEFORE_RELEASE_VIOLATION: RX releases plaintext without tag verification
B3 replay protection missing (required for real MACsec)
B4 integrated oracle not independent + production parameter not tested
gaps: SA key lifecycle & atomic switch (cached-SA risk: H/Y vs key mismatch, old frame uses new H)

replay protection: lowAcceptable PN / window / dup / old / out-of-order / wrap
nonce uniqueness: TX & RX use separate direction keys OR unique SSCI assignment; PN not rolled back by reset (please recheck) ; wrap fail-closed
SA lifecycle: SA table, active/retired, generation, key atomic switch, zeroization of key/H samples
event fingerprint {direction, frame_seq, SA, AN, PN, generation} for drop/error counting
fix routed timing WNS<=0, then post-synth / routed security sim
